name: ShapeBlur-TS-TW
title: Shape Blur Effect
description: A thin white rounded-square frame on black grows a smoky grey bloom wherever the pointer hovers, the glow sliding along the outline with a damped lag.
use: A minimal hero needs a quiet shape that still reacts to the pointer.
avoid: It is a full-screen WebGL canvas, so it needs a sized parent and costs GPU time even at rest.
a11y: Decorative with nothing to operate; it needs a pointer and does not check reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single crisp rounded-square outline, one thin white stroke, centred on black. Near the pointer the line breaks into a broad soft grey plume that fades outward.
behaves: The pointer drags a blurred bulge along the square's edge, its brightness falling off with distance from the cursor. When the pointer leaves, the outline draws clean again.
customise: Variation (rounded square, circle, ring or triangle), pixel ratio, shape size, roundness, border size and the hover circle's size and edge are props.
weight: moderate: A single full-screen shader quad redrawn every frame, with a damped pointer position.
